description: Creates a shareable page of chosen homes at cielstay.com/s/<id>, with a preview picture for link previews. Anyone with the link can see it: the homes, their photos and booking links, and the dates, party size and title given here. It holds no personal details; a title containing an email address or phone number is refused. The same homes, title and dates within a day return the same link. Takes 1 to 10 ids from search_vacation_rentals or get_listing_details.

listingIds.description: The homes to put on the page, by CielStay id

title.description: A title for the page, for example "Zion, March, 6 of us". Defaults to "Shortlist"

name: save_shortlist
title: Share a shortlist
